  1. io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley

Uses of Package
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley

  • Classes in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley used by io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Class
    Description
    CausalClock
    A vector clock (Fidge 1988; Mattern 1988, "Virtual Time and Global States of Distributed Systems") over causal coordinates: a set of (topic, partition) → offset entries, indexed by channel — the topic-partition — rather than by process, a stated variant of the classical form (Kafka's partition is the stable, durable axis a process identity is not).
    CausalClock.Builder
    Builder for CausalClock.
    CausalCoordinateException
    A CausalDeliveryException anchored to a single source coordinate — the (topic, topicId, partition, offset) quartet identifying the record the failure is about, exposed for operator diagnostics.
    CausalDeliveryException
    Base of every exception Parsley's causal machinery throws out of a processing task.
    CausalProcessedStream
    A causal stage bound to its processor, ready to declare sink(s) with CausalProcessedStream.to(String) and then terminate the topology with CausalProcessedStream.build().
    CausalStream
    One or more causal source topics, ready to feed a single causal-decorated processor with CausalStream.process(ProcessorSupplier).
    CausalTopology
    The immutable causal topology CausalProcessedStream.build() produces: the single declared stage's source topics, processor, sink(s), and partitioner.
